subject: Post-call: Acme Corp TCO recap & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: Acme Corp TCO recap & next steps

Alex —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and can get you a compact TCO view: 

What we heard (pain & goals)
- High token volume for customer-facing chat (avg 1.2k tokens/session) driving monthly spend variability.
- Latency spikes during morning PST peak impacting conversion on live chat flows.
- Security/regulatory requirement for audit logs and region control (must run in us-west).
- Cost target: tighten monthly inference spend to under $45k while improving p99 latency and reliability.

Key Redwood levers we discussed
- Token economics: model choice + response length controls (expected 20–30% token reduction by prompting + model variant).
- Batching & caching: prefix KV caching for chatbot flows and adaptive batching for async workloads (projected 25–40% token and inference cost reduction on warm paths).
- Quantization & reserved capacity: Dedicated pools + 4-bit quantized variants for steady-state throughput to lower per-token price.

Proposed next steps
1) I attached a first-pass TCO calc that uses your session metrics — please confirm the monthly MAU and avg tokens/session. (attachment: acme_tco_calculation_v1.xlsx)
2) Sync with procurement to capture contract/term constraints — looping them in when you’re ready.
3) Schedule a 45-min runbook + SE call next week to validate batching/caching approach on a sample workload.
4) We'll provide a 60-day pilot pricing/Reserved capacity quote once we align on traffic profile.

Quick ask: can you share the typical daily concurrency (peak requests/min) and whether you need on-prem or VPC-only deployment?

Thanks again — happy to adjust the TCO sheet after you confirm the numbers.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: acme_tco_calculation_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_pricing_summary.pdf (summary PDF)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme Corp TCO recap & next steps

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and the quick turnaround on the TCO sheet. A few notes: 
- Avg tokens/session is about 1,150 (we see a long tail where power users hit ~3.5k).
- Peak concurrency: roughly 220 req/min during the 10–11am PST window.
- We need the solution to be within our us-west region (data residency).
- Procurement: we'll need a standard SOW + security addendum; procurement@acme.com is on cc.

We can confirm MAU and exact concurrency numbers by tomorrow EOB.

Also: would a 30-day pilot with 50k sessions be sufficient to validate enterprise SLAs for us?

Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Product — Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com
